description: Remove CloudFormation and make the repo self-explanatory for a non-expert deploying from another machine (plan item 4). Delete iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/), update every reference outside .kiro/ and aidlc-docs/, and write the Spanish deployment guide docs/despliegue-aws.md (PowerShell + bash for every command) plus docs/terraform-arquitectura.md (validated Mermaid + text fallback). Update the README. Depends on FEAT-005..007: read their `findings` first and reuse their exact names, which the plan lists in section 2.
steps: Read the `findings` of FEAT-005, FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 (and envs/dev/variables.tf, outputs.tf, bootstrap/variables.tf, outputs.tf, package.json) so every name in the docs matches the code exactly.

Replace the cfn-lint/validate-template commands with terraform fmt/validate. Replace the `iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/)` mentions in 'Known MVP gaps' and in the layout tree with `infra/terraform/`. Add `bun run build:lambda` / `verify:lambda` to the commands. Add a gap bullet that the AWS path is validated offline only. Mention the async upload (202 + polling) on AWS. In src/providers/aws/*.ts make sure no comment still names template.yaml or CloudFormation (FEAT-005 should have done it; re-check).

Annotate the historical workflow artifacts: in .agents/tasks/plan.md, context.json, task.json, review.json and features/FEAT-001.json..FEAT-004.json replace each `iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/)` / `iac\\template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/)` occurrence with `iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/)`. Keep the JSON valid: parse each edited JSON file with `bun -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(p,'utf8'))"`.

Write docs/despliegue-aws.md in Spanish (UTF-8 via the file write tool), aimed at someone who is not an AWS expert. Every shell step has TWO fenced blocks labeled PowerShell and bash. Sections, in order: (1) Qué se despliega y cuánto cuesta (short summary + link to the architecture doc). (2) Requisitos previos, with versions and check commands: git (`git --version`), bun ≥ 1.4.4 (`bun --version`), Terraform ≥ 1.10 with 1.11+ recommended (`terraform version`; install via winget `Hashicorp.Terraform` / the official zip / brew / apt, version por confirmar), AWS CLI v2 (`aws --version`), credentials with profile `agilia` (`aws configure --profile agilia` or SSO, then set the profile: PowerShell `$env:AWS_PROFILE="agilia"`, bash `export AWS_PROFILE=agilia`), and `aws sts get-caller-identity` with an example JSON output and what each field means. Region us-east-2 (`$env:AWS_REGION="us-east-2"` / export). (3) Clonar: `git clone https://github.com/JesusBMC/AguilIA.git` + cd. (4) `bun install`. (5) Pruebas: `bunx tsc --noEmit`, `bun test` (expected: 0 fail). (6) Construir Lambdas: `bun run build:lambda` + `bun run verify:lambda` (expected output). (7) Bootstrap del estado remoto: copy terraform.tfvars.example → terraform.tfvars (Copy-Item / cp) and edit budget_alert_email; `terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/bootstrap init`, `plan`, `apply`; explain that it creates the state bucket + budget and writes envs/dev/backend.hcl; Budgets emails arrive with no confirmation; keep the bootstrap terraform.tfstate safe (it stays local). (8) Desplegar dev: copy tfvars and edit alert_email and bedrock_model_id; `terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/envs/dev init -backend-config=backend.hcl`, `plan -out=tfplan`, `apply tfplan`; what the plan shows (approximate resource count), how long it takes (CloudFront ~5-15 min, por confirmar); `terraform output` with every output name explained. (9) Habilitar Bedrock: console steps in us-east-2 (Model catalog → Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 → use-case form → playground test) per plan D9, the CLI checks `aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --region us-east-2 --type-equals SYSTEM_DEFINED --query "inferenceProfileSummaries[?contains(inferenceProfileId,'claude-haiku-4-5')].inferenceProfileId"` and `aws bedrock get-inference-profile`, and how to change bedrock_model_id. Mark the console labels 'por confirmar'. (10) Crear el primer usuario Cognito: admin-create-user (email + email_verified=true, --message-action SUPPRESS), admin-set-user-password --permanent (read the password with Read-Host / read -s, never put it in a file), admin-add-user-to-group BolsaTeam, using `terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/envs/dev output -raw cognito_user_pool_id`. (11) Publicar y abrir la SPA: Terraform already uploads web/ and config.js; open `terraform output -raw frontend_url`, sign in, run the flow; the upload is async (Procesando en AWS…); force an update with `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ... --paths "/*"` if needed. (12) Prueba de humo, with expected outputs: `curl.exe -s <frontend_url>/health` and `<api_url>/health` → {"status":"ok","auth":"cognito"}; without a token, GET /search?q=valor → 401 {"message":"Unauthorized"}; get an ID token with `aws cognito-idp admin-initiate-auth --auth-flow ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH ... --query AuthenticationResult.IdToken --output text`; authenticated GET /search?q=valor → 200 {"query":"valor","results":[...]}; POST /documents/upload with samples text → 202 RECEIVED, then poll GET /documents/<id> until DRAFTED (PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod examples + bash curl). (13) Actualizar después de `git pull`: bun install → tests → build:lambda → terraform plan/apply (the Lambda alias and SPA objects update). (14) Rollback: git rollback (checkout of the previous commit/tag, build, apply) and fast rollback (`aws lambda list-versions-by-function`, `aws lambda update-alias --name live --function-version N`), with the warning that the next apply re-points the alias. (15) Destrucción total: order env first, then bootstrap. Set force_destroy_buckets = true + apply (or empty the buckets with `aws s3 rm s3://<bucket> --recursive` plus the versions note), `terraform destroy` in envs/dev, then for bootstrap remove prevent_destroy (explained), empty the versioned state bucket, `terraform destroy`; Budgets is deleted with bootstrap. (16) Solución de problemas: table of error → cause → fix, covering at least ExpiredToken/no credentials, AccessDenied on apply, BucketAlreadyExists / BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou in bootstrap (terraform import), backend.hcl missing, state lock held (`terraform force-unlock` with care), archive_file 'no such file' (run build:lambda), Bedrock AccessDeniedException / ValidationException 'on-demand throughput isn't supported' (use the us. profile id), Cognito redirect_mismatch, 401 in the SPA (expired token), CloudFront serving an old version, Lambda timeout / DLQ messages (CloudWatch Logs `aws logs tail /aws/lambda/agilia-worker-dev --follow`), the budget alert never arriving (credits; include_credit=false). (17) Costos estimados: monthly table (servicio | supuesto de uso | costo estimado USD | fuente) for every deployed resource + OpenSearch enabled + the omitted NAT/ElastiCache/OpenSearch Serverless for comparison. Use only AWS pricing page links (https://aws.amazon.com/<service>/pricing/). Every price not read from an AWS page this session is marked 'por confirmar'. If you can fetch AWS pricing pages, use them; never invent numbers. Add the line 'Contenido de precios parafraseado; verifique en la Calculadora de precios de AWS (https://calculator.aws/)'. (18) Notas de seguridad: IAM roles created and their risk (2 Lambda roles least privilege, Cognito, budget; deployer needs admin-like permissions), OpenSearch public endpoint + IAM risk assessment (plan D4), omitted VPC, no secrets in git (terraform.tfvars, backend.hcl, *.tfstate gitignored; tfvars.example committed), state contains sensitive data → bucket encrypted + versioned + private, admin-only user creation, API logging deliberately off to avoid PII, Bedrock geo routing (data may be processed in us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2). (19) Limitaciones conocidas (plan section 5).

Write docs/terraform-arquitectura.md in Spanish: a short intro, a Mermaid `flowchart LR` covering Usuario → CloudFront → (S3 SPA | API Gateway + Cognito authorizer) → Lambda api → (S3, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge) and SQS → Lambda worker → (Textract, Comprehend, Bedrock, S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch opcional), plus CloudWatch/X-Ray/CloudTrail and Budgets (bootstrap). Mermaid rules: node ids alphanumeric with no spaces, ALL labels in double quotes, edges `-->` or `-.->` (dotted for optional), no parentheses/accents outside quotes, `subgraph id["Etiqueta"]` ... `end`. Then a 'Versión en texto' numbered-list fallback describing the same flow, a module table (módulo | recursos | archivo), and the parity summary (what was omitted and why: VPC/NAT/ElastiCache/classifier/event-chain).

Validate the Mermaid: try `bunx -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc -i docs/terraform-arquitectura.md -o .data/mermaid-check.md` (cwd worktree, timeout 300000). If it cannot run (Chromium download/EPERM), fall back to extracting the mermaid block and checking it against the rules above by careful review. Record which method was used in findings, and delete any generated .data/mermaid-check* files.

Final consistency checks: `git grep -n -i "template.yaml\|cloudformation" -- . ":!.kiro" ":!aidlc-docs"` returns only the annotated historical mentions in .agents/tasks plus intentional explanatory mentions ('reemplaza CloudFormation') in the docs/README. Every `terraform output -raw <name>` and `var` name in the docs exists in outputs.tf/variables.tf (check each). Every `bun run <script>` exists in package.json.

NOTES FOR REVIEW: (1) PowerShell snippets avoid `$pwd` (automatic variable) and quote Cognito `Name=...,Value=...` shorthand (an unquoted comma would become an array). (2) admin-initiate-auth uses the shorthand `USERNAME=..,PASSWORD=..`, so the guide tells users not to put ',' or '"' in the test password. FIX (docs only): section 12.3 said the polling shows intermediate statuses (EXTRACTED, ANALYZED, VALIDATED) before DRAFTED. On AWS the worker runs runPipeline in-process and the only traceStore.saveDocument calls are submitUpload (RECEIVED), pipeline persist (DRAFTED) and worker markFailed (ERROR), so the API only ever returns RECEIVED -> DRAFTED or ERROR. The sentence now says RECEIVED until DRAFTED and that no intermediate statuses are shown. No code or behavior change.
